name: Sionna Visualizer
description: Full-stack web dashboard (Angular + Spring Boot + Python + PostgreSQL) for visualizing NVIDIA Sionna 6G simulation results including BER, beam patterns, path loss, and channel capacity.

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker-compose up starts all 4 services locally

eval_notes: Docker-compose with 4 services (Angular frontend, Java backend, Python Sionna bridge, PostgreSQL). Useful for evaluating AI agent ability to configure and interpret 6G simulation dashboards. Active development with 2 releases.
